note: The two ways a unit of the pixel sweep runs on a card. A worker takes the first profile whose card memory range holds its card (minimum_card_memory_mb <= memory < card_memory_below_mb; null means no upper bound). The learner and environment settings are the command-line JSON of the archived baseline of 2026-11-06 (its units/make_final_units.py): one copy on the RTX A4500, four copies on the H100 NVL. A unit keeps the profile of its first start; the settings used are written into its queue record then.

one copy.memory_note: One copy with these settings used 8.6 GB of card memory and 6 GB of host memory (RTX 5080, 2026-11-07). The 10,000 MB floor lets an RTX 2080 Ti (about 10,850 MB) take a unit; its speed check decides whether that card type is used.
